name: Design system
description: Which design system the desk's components are made of: the endue design system, or an installed plugin of kind design-system that desk.design.active names (ADR 0090). The design system studio and the desk.design.* commands change it.

desk.design.active.description: The design system plugin in force, by id (a plugin of kind design-system, ADR 0090); empty for the endue design system. Installing a design system does not apply it.

desk.design.markets.description: The design system markets the design system studio's Market tab lists, by the https URL of each index (ADR 0091), after desk.theme.markets: the first market that lists an id wins. The default is this repository's market/design-systems.
